records.jp: 今は当たり前に入ってるけど、<CR>現実の学校では屋上って立入禁止だったんだよね
records.en_original: We use the roof here all the time like it's nothing, but at my school it was off-limits.
records.en: We use the roof here all the time like it's nothing, but at my school it was off-limits.

records.jp: あ、わたしもそうだった。入れなかったよね
records.en_original: Ours too. The doors were always locked.
records.en: Ours too. The doors were always locked.

records.jp: 漫画やアニメだと定番の場所なんだけど
records.en_original: It's funny, you see it all the time in manga and anime and stuff.
records.en: It's funny, you see it all the time in manga and anime and stuff.

records.jp: へえ、そうなんだ。例えば？
records.en_original: Really? How so?
records.en: Really? How so?

records.jp: 屋上って、出会いが生まれる場所なんだよ
records.en_original: It's a place where people meet.
records.en: It's a place where people meet.

records.jp: 孤独な主人公が、人目を避けるために屋上へ。<CR>そして同じく独りで過ごす女子と出会って……
records.en_original: A lonely protagonist heads to the rooftop to avoid people, but instead meets a lonely girl...
records.en: A lonely protagonist heads to the rooftop to avoid people, but instead meets a lonely girl...

records.jp: ……みたいな。<CR>ちょっと特別な出会いが生まれる場所
records.en_original: Or something like that. It's the perfect setting for a special encounter.
records.en: Or something like that. It's the perfect setting for a special encounter.

records.jp: 特別な出会い……か。<CR>愛央ちゃんはそういうの憧れる？
records.en_original: Meeting someone special, huh... Do you ever wish for things like that would happen to you?
records.en: Meeting someone special, huh... Do you ever wish for things like that would happen to you?

records.jp: まあ、ちょっとはね。でも、それってここに来てから<CR>何度もあったからさ。わりと叶っちゃったかも
records.en_original: Kind of, I guess. Though since I've came here I've had quite a few moments like that. Dream come true!
records.en: Kind of, I guess. Though since I've came here I've had quite a few moments like that. Dream come true!

records.jp: ふふ、そうだね。わたしも同じ
records.en_original: Hehe, that's right. The same goes for me.
records.en: Hehe, that's right. The same goes for me.

records.jp: 屋上でバトル！　やっぱりこれでしょ
records.en_original: It's a classic battleground!
records.en: It's a classic battleground!

records.jp: バトル……？
records.en_original: Battle...?
records.en: Battle...?

records.jp: 学校にやってくる敵っていうのは、大体空から来るの。<CR>だから屋上で迎え撃つ！　学園ものの定番！
records.en_original: Enemies always come from the sky for some reason, so you gotta catch 'em on the roof!
records.en: Enemies always come from the sky for some reason, so you gotta catch 'em on the roof!

records.jp: ……って、私たちそれもうやっちゃってるよね
records.en_original: Now that I think about it, that's exactly what we did.
records.en: Now that I think about it, that's exactly what we did.

records.jp: そういえばそうだね。<CR>なるほど、あれって定番だったんだ……
records.en_original: That's true. I see, so it's quite common in anime and manga, is it?
records.en: That's true. I see, so it's quite common in anime and manga, is it?

records.jp: 実際体感すると、正直勘弁してよって感じ……。<CR>頼りになる仲間がいて良かったよ
records.en_original: After experiencing it for myself, I'm not sure how much I like it though... I'm lucky to have such reliable friends.
records.en: After experiencing it for myself, I'm not sure how much I like it though... I'm lucky to have such reliable friends.

records.jp: 愛央ちゃんだってそうだよ。<CR>頼りにしてるのです、リーダー
records.en_original: So are we, Ao. You're our leader.
records.en: So are we, Ao. You're our leader.

records.jp: そういえば、愛央ちゃんがここに来てすぐの頃、さ
records.en_original: That reminds me of when you first came here.
records.en: That reminds me of when you first came here.

records.jp: うん？
records.en_original: Hm?
records.en: Hm?

records.jp: ここで一人で考え事したりしてたよね
records.en_original: You did a lot of thinking alone here.
records.en: You did a lot of thinking alone here.

records.jp: えっ！？　し、知ってたんだ……
records.en_original: Wait, you knew about that?!
records.en: Wait, you knew about that?!

records.jp: 恥ずかしいなあ……。<CR>あの頃は色々不安だったから
records.en_original: That's embarrassing... But I was worried about a lot back then.
records.en: That's embarrassing... But I was worried about a lot back then.

records.jp: もっとわたしたちに相談してくれたら良かったのに
records.en_original: You could have come and talked to us, you know?
records.en: You could have come and talked to us, you know?

records.jp: みんなに気を遣わせたくなかったっていうか……<CR>今なら、絶対そうするよ
records.en_original: I guess I didn't want to bother you all... I mean, I would definitely go to you now.
records.en: I guess I didn't want to bother you all... I mean, I would definitely go to you now.

records.jp: ふふ。約束だよ？
records.en_original: Hehe. You better.
records.en: Hehe. You better.

records.jp: ま、それも良い思い出だね。今となっては
records.en_original: Looking back now, those are some good memories.
records.en: Looking back now, those are some good memories.

records.jp: 屋上から愛央ちゃんの叫び声が聞こえてきた時は<CR>何事かと思ったよ。「わけわかんない！」って
records.en_original: I was so surprised when I heard you yell from the rooftop. All of a sudden hearing, "I just don't get it!"
records.en: I was so surprised when I heard you yell from the rooftop. All of a sudden hearing, "I just don't get it!"

records.jp: それも聞かれてたの！？
records.en_original: You heard that too?!
records.en: You heard that too?!

records.jp: やっぱ恥ずかしい……忘れて……
records.en_original: That's so embarrassing... Please just delete it from your memory.
records.en: That's so embarrassing... Please just delete it from your memory.

records.jp: ううん。忘れないよ。<CR>これも愛央ちゃんとの思い出の一ページだから
records.en_original: Nope, never. It's one of my most precious memories of you.
records.en: Nope, never. It's one of my most precious memories of you.

records.jp: ふー……。いい景色……
records.en_original: Whew... What a beautiful view.
records.en: Whew... What a beautiful view.

records.jp: 愛央ちゃんもこっちおいでよ。いい眺めだよ
records.en_original: Come look, Ao. The view is incredible!
records.en: Come look, Ao. The view is incredible!

records.jp: 落ちないように気をつけてよ
records.en_original: Careful you don't fall, you hear me?
records.en: Careful you don't fall, you hear me?

records.jp: ふふ……落ちないよ
records.en_original: Hehe... I won't.
records.en: Hehe... I won't.

records.jp: こうやって手を握ってたら、大丈夫
records.en_original: I'll be fine as long as I hold your hand.
records.en: I'll be fine as long as I hold your hand.

records.jp: そだね
records.en_original: Yeah.
records.en: Yeah.

records.jp: ……あ、でも。万が一こころが落ちたら、<CR>私の力で支えられるかな……
records.en_original: But if you do fall, I don't think I'm strong enough to hold onto you.
records.en: But if you do fall, I don't think I'm strong enough to hold onto you.

records.jp: わたしそんなに重くないもん……
records.en_original: I'm not that heavy...
records.en: I'm not that heavy...

records.jp: ごめん、冗談。<CR>こころが落ちそうになっても絶対助けるよ
records.en_original: I was just joking. If you look like you're gonna fall, I'll definitely save you.
records.en: I was just joking. If you look like you're gonna fall, I'll definitely save you.

records.jp: もう……
records.en_original: Jeez...
records.en: Jeez...

records.jp: ……ちょっと怖いかも。<CR>うっかり落ちちゃったらと思うと
records.en_original: I'm a little scared... I don't wanna fall.
records.en: I'm a little scared... I don't wanna fall.

records.jp: 大丈夫だよ
records.en_original: It's okay.
records.en: It's okay.

records.jp: わたしが手、握ってるから
records.en_original: I'll hold your hand.
records.en: I'll hold your hand.

records.jp: ……そっか。それなら安心だ
records.en_original: Okay... That makes it a little less scary.
records.en: Okay... That makes it a little less scary.

records.jp: んー！　いい眺め！　開放感！
records.en_original: Wow! What a view!
records.en: Wow! What a view!

records.jp: でもやっぱりちょっと怖い……。<CR>こころ、手離さないでよね！
records.en_original: But it's still a little scary. Don't let go of my hand, Kokoro!
records.en: But it's still a little scary. Don't let go of my hand, Kokoro!

records.jp: うん。絶対離さない
records.en_original: I would never.
records.en: I would never.

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>%s<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
